title: Normalized marked nodal dualizing and component-degree data
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme and $P=(p:X	o T,D\hookrightarrow X)$ a multipointed curve [def-trf-multipointed-curve]. For an $\mathcal O_X$-module $\omega$, define $L_P(\omega)=\omega\otimes\mathcal I_D^\vee$, using the actual marking ideal [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] and sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For a field $\Omega$, an integral scheme $Z$ [def-pc-integral-scheme], maps $j:Z	o Y$ and $s:Z	o\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$, and a module $M$ on $Y$, put $\deg_{Z,\Omega}(j^*M)=\deg_\Omega(
u_Z^*j^*M)$ and $g_\Omega(Z)=p_a(Z^
u)$, with structural map $s\circ
u_Z$, using the canonical normalization $
u_Z:Z^
u	o Z$ of the integral scheme $Z$ in its function field [def-sc-normalization] (for integral $Z$ this is its reduced normalization [def-weil-pbc-reduced-normalization]), module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], degree [def-pc-degree-line-bundle], and arithmetic genus [def-pc-genus]. Composition in the structural map means $Z^
u\xrightarrow{
u_Z}Z\xrightarrow{s}\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$. For $t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega	o T$ and an integral component inclusion $j:Z	o X_t$, put $B_P(t,Z)=(
u_Z\circ j)^{-1}(D_t\cup(X_t\setminus\operatorname{Sm}(X_t/\Omega)))$, where [def-trf-multipointed-curve-modification] supplies the marking base change and smooth locus is as in [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. A marked nodal dualizing degree datum on $P$ consists of $\omega$, a normalized nodal dualizing datum $c:\Omega^1_{X/T}	o\omega$ [def-trf-nodal-dualizing-datum], an effective Cartier marking [def-trf-effective-cartier-center] [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal], invertibility of $L_P(\omega)$ [def-sc-invertible-module], and the following properties. For every normalized datum $c':\Omega^1_{X/T}	o F$, there is a unique isomorphism $e:\omega\simeq F$ with $e\circ c=c'$. For every $q:T'	o T$, the pullback of $\omega$ has a normalized datum whose fundamental class on the pulled-back generator $1\otimes da$ [def-a1-relative-differentials-pullback-map] is the base change of $c(da)$; $D_{T'}\hookrightarrow X_{T'}$ is Cartier and the pullback of $L_P(\omega)$ is isomorphic to $\omega_{T'}\otimes\mathcal I_{D_{T'}}^\vee$. For every algebraically closed $\Omega$, every $t$, and every integral closed component $Z\hookrightarrow X_t$ proper over $\Omega$, the set $B_P(t,Z)$ is finite and $\deg_\Omega(
u_Z^*j^*L_P(\omega))=2g_\Omega(Z)-2+\#B_P(t,Z)$. These are the fields of a structure; no existence assertion or positivity assumption is part of this definition.
